evidence.property: Cache scales configured WAD threshold to live quote units, clamps sub-unit values to one, saturates overflow, and falls back for short/reverting/unsupported metadata. Hostile gas consumption is a reproduced limitation, not a passing totality guarantee.

consumers: setLiveKey and setLegacyBuyback refresh the cache; _tryLegacyBuy and legacyBuyStep compare live quote buffers against the raw threshold
evidence.limitations: PoolManager stub and mocked ordinary metadata; actual hostile metadata contract for exhaustion. No full native-pool lifecycle, deployment parity, large-returndata bound or comprehensive access-control coverage is claimed. EVIDENCE_RECORDED is not full node acceptance.
